title: Mann nach Gewalttat gesucht – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe

extraction.summaryEn: Police are seeking an unidentified suspect over a dispute on 29 April 2025 near the Alexanderplatz S-Bahn station in which a 36-year-old was stabbed in the thigh by a group. The suspect is described by police and images from a surveillance camera were released.
